title: Electric Eel Ka Dangerous Shock! ⚡ #shorts
idea: Electric eel can generate 860 volts of electricity, which is nearly four times a household wall outlet.

lines.text: Ek chhota sa fish de sakta hai jaanleva jhatka!
Electric eel generate kar sakti hai up to 860 volts!
Yeh voltage ghar ke normal wall outlet se lagbhag chaar guna zyada hai.
Inka yeh high voltage current shikaar ko pal bhar mein stun kar deta hai.
Inke paas teen alag electric organs hote hain jo current banate hain.
Kya aapne kabhi kisi electric fish ko dekha hai?

facts.claim: Electric eel can generate an electrical shock of up to 860 volts, nearly four times a household wall outlet.
Electric eels have three pairs of electric organs arranged longitudinally.
